1.text: Zaburi iyi yahimbiwe umutware w'abaririmbyi babwirisha inanga ijwi ryitwa “Inuma iceceka y'aba kure.” Ni Zaburi ya Dawidi yitwa Mikitamu, yahimbye ubwo Abafilisitiya bamufatiraga i Gati.

2.text: Mana, mbabarira kuko abantu bashaka kumira,Biriza umunsi bandwanya bakampata.

3.text: Abanzi banjye biriza umunsi bashaka kumira,Kuko abandwananya agasuzuguro ari benshi.

5.text: Imana izampa gushima izina ryayo,Imana ni yo niringiye sinzatinya,Abantu babasha kuntwara iki?

6.text: Biriza umunsi bagoreka amagambo yanjye,Bibwira ibyo kungirira nabi bisa.

7.text: Baraterana bakihisha,Bakaronda ibirenge byanjye,Kuko bubikiye ubugingo bwanjye.

8.text: Mbese gukiranirwa kwabo kuzabakirisha?Mana, tsinda amahanga hasi n'umujinya wawe.

9.text: Ubara kurorongotana kwanjye,Ushyira amarira yanjye mu icupa ryawe,Mbese ntiyanditswe mu gitabo cyawe?

10.text: Icyo gihe abanzi banjye bazasubizwa inyuma ku munsi nzatakiramo,Ibyo ndabizi kuko Imana iri mu ruhande rwanjye.

11.text: Imana izampa gushima izina ryayo,Uwiteka azampa gushima izina rye.

12.text: Imana ni yo niringiye sinzatinya,Abantu babasha kuntwara iki?

13.text: Mana, imihigo naguhize indiho,Kandi nzakwitura amaturo y'ishimwe.

14.text: Kuko wakijije ubugingo bwanjye urupfu,N'ibirenge byanjye wabikijije gusitara,Ngo mbone uko ngendera mu maso y'Imana mu mucyo w'ababaho.
